limitations: No automated metric establishes dance fidelity, identity, or a quality winner.
bbox aspect is an upright proxy, not a skeleton or gait classifier.
Source/master coordinates are recovered on visible cropped support only.
POST background ratio 1 is expected by source copying outside the union, not evidence of corrected foreground motion.
